'''Spooky Armor''' is an {{Epic}} [[Armor]] set bought from the [[Fear Mongerer]]. It increases the player's chance of obtaining [[Green Candy|Green]] and [[Purple Candy]] from the [[Spooky Festival]].

== Obtaining ==
'''Spooky Armor''' can be purchased from the {{NPCSprite|Fear Mongerer}} during the [[Spooky Festival]]. Each armor piece costs {{Item|Purple Candy|amount=64}}.
